business_summary:
Yushiro Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells metalworking oils and fluids, and building maintenance products in Japan, the Americas, the United States, China, Southeast Asia, and India. The company offers cutting and grinding oils and fluids, including water miscible cutting and grinding fluids, and straight cutting and grinding oils; forming oils and fluids comprising water miscible cold rolling oils, straight rolling oils, hot rolling oils for seamless pipes, and non-graphite hot forging oils, as well as drawing, pressing oils and cold forging oils; and surface treatment agents, such as rust preventives, metal cleaners, car paint protective coatings, and car body protective waxes. It also provides water miscible cutting fluids for inner diamond blade saws; straight slurry bases for multi blade and multi wire saws, fire resistant water miscible slurry bases for multi wire saw, and water miscible slurry bases for multi wire saw; grinding fluids for aluminum and glass disks, and diamond slurries for magnetic heads; aluminum and magnesium diecast lubricants, urethane foam mold release agents, and plunger tip lubricants; aquaous quenchant products; fire resistant hydraulic fluids; and deodoran products. In addition, the company offers building maintenance products, including floor polishing chemicals, such as urethane and acrylic resin waxes, and water and oil-based floor waxes; floor cleaners comprising surface cleaners, stripping agents, and carpet cleaners; hand soaps; and floor maintenance equipment, including maintenance riding carts. Further, provides 
machinery and equipment, and transportation equipment. The company was formerly known as Yushiro Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yushiro Inc. in April 2025. Yushiro Inc. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.
